description:
United by programming, we teamed up for the NASA Space Apps Challenge, each with a defined role. 

Marcelo led us and drove the creative vision. 

Elaine our front-end developer, designed and built an initial prototype. 

Kaio and Leonardo researched NASA’s data and resources, selecting the most useful. 

Marcela built the presentation website detailing the application.

Jhenifer handled final touches and texts. 

Together, we are confident in presenting our idea.
